title: You Need Six Months of Expenses Saved (Myth)
description:
Everyone says six months. Almost nobody has six months. Here is the number that actually matters - and why six months is advice for someone else.

Mira's Myth Busters on Fiscalore. New shorts Tuesdays and Fridays.
